beats.say: Resident Evil just entered the Game of the Year fight.
Requiem is nominated at The Game Awards 2026.
It's the 9th main Resident Evil game.
It launched on February 27 this year.
You play FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft.
And the story goes back to Raccoon City.
007 First Light and Zelda are fighting too.
Is Requiem the real Game of the Year?
